blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Calapan City Council on Wednesday passed two resolutions opposing the proposed declaration of a 10,000-hectare mineral reservation, including parts of San Teodoro and popular tourist destination Puerto Galera. The council also authorized the city’s legal office to pursue legal action against the plan. In the first resolution, the Sangguniang Panlungsod strongly objected the proposed establishment of a gold mineral reservation, citing potential environmental, ecological, economic and social consequences that could extend beyond the two municipalities and affect the entire province.
